source.title: LGE2021 Councillor Lists - 20 Nov 2021
source.reportingPeriod: Councillors elected in the 2021 Local Government Elections
source.methodology: Party seat counts were aggregated from the official elected-councillor list by municipality code. The listed ward and PR seat types are counted separately. Names and identifier fields were discarded; only aggregate counts are retained.
source.limitations: Historical elected-councillor snapshot published 20 November 2021. It does not reflect later vacancies, by-elections, officeholders, mayors, coalitions or the 2026 local government election results.
